body.purpose: Prompts, explanations, and general UI copy.

label.purpose: Controls, filters, status, and compact metadata.

shadows.name: approval-lift
shadows.purpose: Approval and decision surfaces that temporarily float above the conversation.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus and validation communication, never decorative elevation.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover color and compact list-item state changes.

motion.name: atmosphere-focus
motion.purpose: Softens landing imagery when the prompt receives focus.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single dominant action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary, #432dd7); color: var(--primary-foreground, #eef2ff); font: 500 14px/1.4 'Geist Variable', Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary, #432dd7) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, #9ca8ab); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, #9ca8ab) 30%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A visible but subordinate action for navigation and account choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e3e7e8); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--background, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #090b0c); font: 500 14px/1.4 'Geist Variable', Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, #f1f3f3); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, #9ca8ab); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, #9ca8ab) 30%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Paper Prompt Composer
components.description: The bright invitation surface used over photographic entry imagery.
components.css: .ds-prompt-paper { position: relative; min-height: 154px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e3e7e8); border-radius: 22px; background: var(--background, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #090b0c); transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-prompt-paper:focus-within { border-color: var(--ring, #9ca8ab); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, #9ca8ab) 30%, transparent); } .ds-prompt-paper textarea { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 96px; padding: 16px 20px 10px; border: 0; outline: 0; resize: none; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 400 18px/28px 'Geist Variable', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-prompt-paper textarea::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #67787c); } .ds-prompt-paper button { position: absolute; right: 16px; bottom: 16px; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--primary, #432dd7); color: var(--primary-foreground, #eef2ff); }

components.name: Workspace Prompt Composer
components.description: The same signature interaction quieted for a white planning surface.
components.css: .ds-prompt-workspace { position: relative; min-height: 154px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 22px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted, #f1f3f3) 50%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, #090b0c); transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-prompt-workspace:focus-within { border-color: var(--ring, #9ca8ab); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, #9ca8ab) 30%, transparent); } .ds-prompt-workspace textarea { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 96px; padding: 16px 20px 10px; border: 0; outline: 0; resize: none; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 400 18px/28px 'Geist Variable', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-prompt-workspace textarea::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #67787c); } .ds-prompt-workspace button { position: absolute; right: 16px; bottom: 16px; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--primary, #432dd7); color: var(--primary-foreground, #eef2ff); }

components.name: Filter Pill
components.description: A compact, neutral collection filter that never competes with the main prompt.
components.css: .ds-filter-pill { display: inline-flex; height: 32px; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 22px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted, #f1f3f3) 50%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, #090b0c); font: 500 14px/1.4 'Geist Variable', Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 100ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-filter-pill:hover { background: var(--muted, #f1f3f3); } .ds-filter-pill:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, #9ca8ab); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, #9ca8ab) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Trip Card
components.description: A flat, container-aware trip row with quiet status metadata.
components.css: .ds-trip-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; padding: 14px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e3e7e8); border-radius: 18px; background: var(--background, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #090b0c); text-decoration: none; font: 400 14px/1.4 'Geist Variable', Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 100ms ease-out, border-color 100ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-trip-card strong { font-weight: 500; } .ds-trip-card small { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #67787c); } .ds-trip-card i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--destructive, #e7000b); } .ds-trip-card:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted, #f1f3f3) 50%, transparent); } .ds-trip-card:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--primary, #432dd7); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary, #432dd7) 20%, transparent); }

components.name: User Message
components.description: A compact end-aligned bubble that distinguishes traveller input from open assistant guidance.
components.html: Make day two slower and swap the flight for a train.
components.css: .ds-message-row { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; width: 100%; } .ds-user-message { box-sizing: border-box; width: fit-content; max-width: 80%; margin: 0; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 22px; background: var(--secondary, #f4f4f5); color: var(--secondary-foreground, #18181b); font: 500 14px/1.6 'Geist Variable', Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Guest Banner
components.description: A full-width account-safety notice that remains warm and action-oriented.
components.html: You're exploring as a guest.Claim this account to keep your trips safe and available anytime.
components.css: .ds-guest-banner { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; padding: 10px 24px; background: var(--primary, #432dd7); color: var(--primary-foreground, #eef2ff); font-family: 'Geist Variable', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-guest-banner div { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; } .ds-guest-banner strong { font-size: 16px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-guest-banner small { color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary-foreground, #eef2ff) 75%, transparent); font-size: 14px; line-height: 18px; } .ds-guest-banner button { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e3e7e8); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--background, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #090b0c); font: 500 14px/1.4 'Geist Variable', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-guest-banner button:hover { background: var(--muted, #f1f3f3); } .ds-guest-banner button:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, white 35%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: Bhromon should feel like arriving at the beginning of a well-considered journey: open, calm, and full of possibility, with enough guidance to make the next step obvious. Entry surfaces are cinematic and emotional; planning surfaces are quiet and utilitarian. Every screen must support the traveller's next thought and reject generic AI spectacle, abstract geometric imagery, and busy marketing surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: One dominant action or decision per surface.
A centered content measure of 768px with 24px mobile gutters.
Generous whitespace and an 8px-centered spacing rhythm, with 12px and 24px used for close relationships.
Expressive serif typography only at the emotional threshold; neutral sans-serif everywhere operational.
Real natural imagery creates anticipation; interface decoration never tries to replace it.
Soft, continuous geometry, hairline boundaries, and almost no decorative elevation.
Responsive layouts preserve hierarchy and emotional scale instead of merely shrinking desktop UI.
Copy speaks to the traveller as a capable collaborator: personal, specific, and quietly encouraging.

rules.name: The Two-Register Rule
rules.body: Inspiration may be cinematic; planning must be calm. Carry the same identity across both through the violet accent, logomark, narrow content measure, rounded controls, and nature imagery.

rules.name: The 768px Rule
rules.body: Default application content to a centered 768px column. Use 24px horizontal gutters below the large breakpoint and remove those gutters only when the full column fits comfortably.

rules.name: The One-Thought Rule
rules.body: Every element must help the traveller express, refine, review, or confirm the next decision. If it does not, remove it.

rules.name: The Violet Rarity Rule
rules.body: Violet signals agency, selection, or important state. It must not wash across routine cards, long text, or decorative backgrounds.

rules.name: The True-White Rule
rules.body: Application surfaces are white or cool neutral. Warm cream, sand, paper, parchment, and beige backgrounds are prohibited.

rules.name: The Natural-Color Rule
rules.body: Let photography carry environmental color. UI colors remain quiet enough that the traveller's destination stays visually dominant.

rules.name: The Threshold Serif Rule
rules.body: Merriweather belongs to the emotional entry point. Do not use it in forms, chat transcripts, lists, filters, account UI, or itinerary controls.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Use natural sentence case. Repeated uppercase labels, tracked eyebrows, and numbered section scaffolding are forbidden.

rules.name: The Comfortable Reading Rule
rules.body: Balance headings, pretty-wrap prose, and keep conversational text airy. Never tighten line height to manufacture density.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces are separated with spacing, a cool tonal shift, or one hairline border. Do not add a shadow simply to make a component feel finished.

rules.name: The One-Boundary Rule
rules.body: A component may use a border or a decorative shadow, never both. Focus rings are state communication and are exempt.

dos: Do begin every surface by identifying the traveller's single next thought or decision.
Do default application content to a centered 768px column with 24px mobile gutters.
Do use the existing semantic color variables and component primitives; extend variants rather than introducing near-duplicate values.
Do reserve Journey Violet for decisive actions, selection, status, focus, and the guest-state banner.
Do use real natural imagery to create anticipation on entry surfaces and a subtle landscape stencil in the workspace.
Do maintain the serif-to-sans transition between emotional entry and operational planning.
Do use generous whitespace: 24px between closely related hero elements, 32px between major workspace groups, and 48–64px for section endings or page breathing room.
Do preserve clear focus rings, WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, reduced-motion behavior, reduced-transparency fallbacks, and safe-area spacing.
Do write warm, personal, specific copy that reinforces traveller agency.
Do test at narrow mobile widths and at the 768px content boundary; hierarchy must survive without horizontal overflow.
donts: Don't create busy marketing surfaces that compete with the traveller's idea.
Don't use cream, sand, parchment, beige, or other warm-neutral page backgrounds; Bhromon's workspace is true white and cool neutral.
Don't spread violet across routine cards or long content. Its rarity is part of the hierarchy.
Don't use Merriweather inside operational UI or turn the product into an editorial-magazine layout.
Don't add repeated uppercase tracked eyebrows, numbered section markers, gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, or identical card grids.
Don't use side-stripe accents, diagonal stripe backgrounds, sketchy SVG illustrations, or colored placeholder rectangles where real imagery belongs.
Don't combine a decorative border with a wide soft shadow. Pick one structural boundary.
Don't invent arbitrary radii. Cards stop at 18px, multiline inputs at 22px, and pills at 26px or fully circular.
Don't place assistant replies in bubbles. Open text is an intentional part of the conversation hierarchy.
Don't shrink expressive type reflexively on mobile; wrap it deliberately and verify every line.
Don't add navigation, explanatory copy, badges, or secondary actions that do not help the traveller take the next step.
